sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。

related.title: IEEE 802.11n A-MPDU：聚合與重試粒度
related.titleEn: IEEE802.11n A-MPDU: aggregation and retry granularity
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付物能重現 12 Mbit/s 與 24 Mbit/s，保留失敗情境且每個通過判定有明確門檻；需分開列出模型未涵蓋的實際系統驗證。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: The artifacts must reproduce 12 Mbit/s and 24 Mbit/s, preserve failing scenarios and attach a threshold to each pass decision; list actual-system validation outside this model separately.
related.difference: 能推導並解釋80.6451612903 %與94.3396226415 %，建立ampdu_bytes.csv、Block_ACK位圖、聚合等待，並完成以下驗收：效率90%目標由10子框通過，但若湊齊需等50 ms且期限20 ms仍不可接受。
related.differenceEn: Derive and explain 80.6451612903 % and 94.3396226415 %; create ampdu_bytes.csv, Block_ACK bitmap and batching delay; apply this acceptance decision: Ten subframes exceed90% efficiency, but a50 ms batching wait fails a20 ms deadline.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 從原理 名義資訊率由資料子載波數、調變位元、碼率與符元時間決定；前導與競爭會再降低MAC有效率。 展開基準式 48*2*0.5/0.000004/1000000；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：先算每符元48與96資訊bit，再數一秒250000符元；確認導頻未算成資料。 將兩條推導一起存入 wifi_ofdm_grid.csv、導頻遮罩、PHY/MAC邊界。

從原理 聚合可攤提前導與競爭時間，但每個子框仍有標頭與錯誤邊界；必須保留Block ACK的子框狀態。 展開基準式 1000/(1000+40+200)*100；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：分開固定與逐框開銷；再造第3子框損毀測例，僅該框重試，不將整聚合算作新payload。 將兩條推導一起存入 ampdu_bytes.csv、Block_ACK位圖、聚合等待。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Starting from Nominal information rate depends on data subcarriers, modulation bits, code rate and symbol duration; preambles and contention reduce MAC goodput., expand baseline expression 48*2*0.5/0.000004/1000000; record intermediate values and units, calculate manually, then repeat with a calculator or Python. Use this independent representation: Compute48/96 information bits per symbol then250000 symbols per second; pilots must not count as data. Save both derivations with wifi_ofdm_grid.csv, pilot mask and PHY/MAC boundary.

Starting from Aggregation amortizes preamble/contention while retaining per-subframe overhead and error boundaries; keep Block ACK subframe outcomes., expand baseline expression 1000/(1000+40+200)*100; record intermediate values and units, calculate manually, then repeat with a calculator or Python. Use this independent representation: Separate fixed/per-frame overhead; corrupt subframe3 and retry only that subframe rather than counting the aggregate as new payload. Save both derivations with ampdu_bytes.csv, Block_ACK bitmap and batching delay.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Bluetooth Classic AFH：壞頻道排除與碰撞比例
related.titleEn: Bluetooth Classic AFH: bad-channel exclusion and collision fraction
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付物能重現 12 Mbit/s 與 24 Mbit/s，保留失敗情境且每個通過判定有明確門檻；需分開列出模型未涵蓋的實際系統驗證。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: The artifacts must reproduce 12 Mbit/s and 24 Mbit/s, preserve failing scenarios and attach a threshold to each pass decision; list actual-system validation outside this model separately.
related.difference: 能推導並解釋25.3164556962 % bad-channel occupancy與7.8125 % bad-channel occupancy，建立afh_channels.csv、排除前後集合、干擾年齡，並完成以下驗收：教學占用率10%上限由第二組通過；另保留頻道數與協定限制，不對真實設備設定頻譜封鎖。
related.differenceEn: Derive and explain 25.3164556962 % bad-channel occupancy and 7.8125 % bad-channel occupancy; create afh_channels.csv, pre/post exclusion sets and interference age; apply this acceptance decision: Only the second passes a10% teaching occupancy cap; retain channel-count/protocol constraints without reconfiguring real spectrum use.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 從原理 名義資訊率由資料子載波數、調變位元、碼率與符元時間決定；前導與競爭會再降低MAC有效率。 展開基準式 48*2*0.5/0.000004/1000000；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：先算每符元48與96資訊bit，再數一秒250000符元；確認導頻未算成資料。 將兩條推導一起存入 wifi_ofdm_grid.csv、導頻遮罩、PHY/MAC邊界。
從原理 自適應跳頻避免已知干擾頻道；以均勻獨立跳頻模型估壞頻道比例，不能把它當實際封包錯誤率。 展開基準式 20/79*100；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：建立79列channel_id與bad/excluded欄，逐列計數；排除頻道不可仍出現在跳頻集合。 將兩條推導一起存入 afh_channels.csv、排除前後集合、干擾年齡。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Starting from Nominal information rate depends on data subcarriers, modulation bits, code rate and symbol duration; preambles and contention reduce MAC goodput., expand baseline expression 48*2*0.5/0.000004/1000000; record intermediate values and units, calculate manually, then repeat with a calculator or Python. Use this independent representation: Compute48/96 information bits per symbol then250000 symbols per second; pilots must not count as data. Save both derivations with wifi_ofdm_grid.csv, pilot mask and PHY/MAC boundary.

Starting from Adaptive hopping avoids known interfered channels; a uniform independent-hop model estimates bad-channel occupancy, not actual packet error rate., expand baseline expression 20/79*100; record intermediate values and units, calculate manually, then repeat with a calculator or Python. Use this independent representation: Build79 rows with channel_id and bad/excluded flags, enumerate counts, and ensure excluded channels leave the hop set. Save both derivations with afh_channels.csv, pre/post exclusion sets and interference age.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
